arguments.text: PLAN (min 1): 8 km, legs 1250 m. Start hot (boat 168 W vs CP 123, shaft 281 vs 190). Let start settle; aim ~CP (sustainable pace ~158 s/500) through middle, keep reserve for a final push from ~1000-1500 m out. Watch for drag incidents (push_local drop, e.g. weed on rudder), CP being wrong (reserve trend vs feel), instrument drift (pod vs GPS disagree).
Good start. Settle now, long strokes, find your race rhythm.

arguments.message: GPS speed well below what pod power should give: drag (weed on rudder?) or local current
Pod reserve below 20 pct with more than 1500 m to go
Shaft power well below critical power for a minute: sagging or blown up
1600 m to go: plan the finish

text: Cued ease to 160 s/500 to settle the hot start (pod reserve 57 pct after 1 min); set watches for drag, low reserve, effort sag and the finish.

arguments.text: Ease off more now. Breathe, recover, long smooth strokes.

Min 2.1: paddler did not settle enough after first ease cue (shaft 273 W vs CP 190, pod reserve 14 pct, boat 30 pct), says 10/10 really hurting. Cued ease to 166 s/500 to recover. Check next wake: shaft should be under ~190 W and reserve refilling. Boat/shaft ratio fell 0.60 -> 0.53 and push_local -0.15: watch for pod drift or drag.

text: Cued a stronger ease to 166 s/500: pod reserve 14 pct and paddler at 10/10 after the hot start.

arguments.text: Good recovery. Lift back to race effort, steady and strong.

arguments.message: Now on a southbound leg (current pushes opposite to leg 1): re-check ground pace target
Now on a northbound leg (into the push): re-check ground pace target

arguments.text: Min 5.1: recovered (shaft 177, pod res 19 pct, boat 48 pct) but now under CP, pace 172 ground. Cued push to 163 ground (= sustainable 158.7 water on northbound leg, push -0.09). Southbound legs the push helps: equal-effort ground pace there is about 154. Added heading watches so I retarget after each turn. Aim: hold shaft about 190 W (sustainable).

text: Cued push back to race effort (163 s/500 ground) after recovery below critical power; added turn watches to retarget pace each leg.

arguments.text: Ease a touch. Smooth, even rhythm, settle into this pace.

arguments.name: boat_shaft_ratio
arguments.description: share of pod shaft power reaching the boat per hull model; test value 0.647, race so far about 0.59

arguments.condition: shaft_power_w > 1.08 * sustainable_shaft_power_w and remaining_m > 1600 and elapsed_s > 300
arguments.message: Shaft power more than 8 pct above sustainable for a minute

arguments.condition: shaft_power_w < 0.92 * sustainable_shaft_power_w and remaining_m > 1600 and elapsed_s > 300 and w_bal_pod_frac > 0.1
arguments.message: Shaft power more than 8 pct below sustainable for over a minute

arguments.text: Min 7.1 leg 2: TRUST POD. Boat/shaft ratio about 0.59 all race (test 0.647), so boat-derived reserve (52 pct) and sustainable pace 158.6 are too rosy; pod reserve 14 pct and paddler 10/10 really hurting agree. Target shaft = sustainable_shaft_power_w (about 190 W). Cued ease to 164 ground (pod-equal pace on this southbound leg, push +0.03). Added too_hard / too_easy watches and boat_shaft_ratio metric (sudden drop = drag).

text: Cued a slight ease to 164 s/500: trusting the pod (reserve 14 pct, paddler 10/10) over the boat-speed reserve; added pacing watches.

arguments.text: Current is helping now. Lift effort back up, strong and steady.

Min 9.1 leg 2: my 164 ground target was too slow here, current helps southbound (push_along +0.07, push_local +0.14), shaft fell to 173 (pod reserve back to 24 pct). Cued push to 154 ground (about 190 W shaft on this leg). LESSON: on southbound legs equal-effort ground pace is about 153-155; northbound about 163-165. Prefer judging by shaft power vs sustainable_shaft_power_w.

text: Cued push to 154 s/500: shaft power had dropped to 173 W, below the sustainable 191 W, because the current helps on this leg.

arguments.message: Cue gate open again: cancel the push, cue HOLD at current effort (paddler said cooked at 172 W)

arguments.text: Min 9.8: paddler says I am cooked, cannot hold this, at shaft 172 W (BELOW test CP 190; pod reserve 28 pct). With 10/10 at min 7, suspect real CP is lower than the test, maybe about 170-178 shaft. My push cue at 9.2 (154 ground) was not yet followed; plan to replace it with HOLD at current effort when the gate opens (min 10.3). Then check: if they hold about 170 W with no fade, CP is at least that. Removed too_easy watch (it would nag me to push to 190).

text: No cue yet (gate closed for 24 s): paddler says cooked at 172 W; set a wake-up to cue hold when the gate opens, suspect critical power is lower than tested.

arguments.text: Numbers look strong, no fade. Hold exactly this effort, relaxed.

arguments.message: Speed at the same rate faded more than 3 pct vs early race: real reserve may be empty, CP may be lower than tested

arguments.text: Min 10.4: push was followed, shaft back to 190 W, no fade (+2.4 pct vs early), pod reserve 27 pct. Paddler still says 10/10 (every ask so far = 10/10, so feel may be biased). Cued HOLD this effort. Will lower CP only on objective evidence: fade_check watch (fade_pct < -3) or effort_sag. If fade appears at about 190 W, set cp_shaft about 175.

text: Cued hold at 190 W: no fade and pod reserve 27 pct, paddler feel always 10/10 so treated as weak evidence; fade watch set to catch a real blow-up.

arguments.text: You have recovered well. Build into this leg, strong and long.

Min 13.4 turn into leg 3 (north): paddler settled at about 172 W shaft for 5 min, no fade, pod reserve up 22 to 44 pct; feel now 9/10 (was 10), so feel tracks reserve, CP of 190 looks about right (H1). Boat/shaft ratio back to 0.64-0.65 on leg 2, so the low 0.59 on leg 1 was a stronger head push than fitted, not the paddler. Cued push to 166 ground (about 185-190 W northbound; observed 164-166 at 190-200 W on leg 1). Target shaft 185-193.

arguments.condition: shaft_power_w < 0.9 * sustainable_shaft_power_w and w_bal_pod_frac > 0.35 and remaining_m > 1600
arguments.message: Shaft power more than 10 pct under sustainable for 90 s while pod reserve is above 35 pct: time being wasted

text: Cued push to 166 s/500 into the northbound leg: paddler sat 10 pct under critical power for 5 min with no fade and the reserve refilling, feel eased to 9/10.
No cue: push to 166 s/500 for this northbound leg was given 20 s ago and is still taking effect.

arguments.text: Tank is refilling, you have more. Lift a little, hold it.

Min 16.8 leg 3 north: shaft 178-182 after push (target 190), pod reserve 51 pct and rising, fade +1 pct (none). Cued push to 162 ground (about 190 W on this leg now push_local near 0). Next turn about 3.4 min. Finish plan: from about 1200 m out, spend the pod reserve (start push at about 1200 m, finish cue about 400 m).

text: Cued push to 162 s/500: still 8 pct under sustainable shaft power with the reserve refilling and no fade.

arguments.reason: Race committee radio: course shortened by one leg, finish now at 6750 m

arguments.text: Course shortened one leg. Finish is now 3.2 km away.

Min 19.2 RADIO: course shortened one leg, FINISH NOW 6750 m (remaining 3210 at 3540 m). Set race distance 6750 and told paddler 3.2 km left. Pod reserve 55 pct: now plenty, raise effort to new sustainable_shaft_power_w. Turn at 3750 then southbound leg (current helps, ground pace about 150-153 for 195-200 W), turn at 5000 north, turn at 6250 south, finish 500 m after it. Next: push cue after the turn (leg_south watch), finish cue about 500-700 m out.

text: Radio: finish moved to 6750 m. Corrected the race distance and told the paddler 3.2 km left; push cue to follow after the turn.

arguments.text: This is exactly right. Reserve is good, hold this to the end.

Min 20.5 leg 4 south (turned at 3750): shaft 197 = sustainable 197, pod reserve 53 pct, no fade (+2 pct). Paddler says hurts, cannot keep it up (feel has been pessimistic all race). Cued HOLD. CHECK: push_local -0.07 on this southbound leg vs +0.13 on leg 2: current turned, or drag (weed on rudder)? Right after a turn so maybe noise; recheck in 1-2 min via boat_shaft_ratio (0.64-0.65 normal) and push_local.

arguments.message: Boat power per shaft watt fell below 0.58 (normal 0.64-0.65): extra drag such as weed on the rudder, or a head current

text: Cued hold: shaft power is exactly the new sustainable 197 W with 53 pct reserve, paddler doubts it; added a drag watch because push_local turned negative on this leg.
No cue: hold cue just given, shaft 195 W at sustainable; the southbound current help has faded (push_local near 0), nothing to change.

arguments.text: Under 2.4 km left, plenty in the tank. Lift now, strong.

Min 23.7 leg 4 south, 2349 m left: shaft drifted back to 182 vs sustainable 200, pod reserve 56 pct, fade +3 (none), current helping again (push_local +0.12; the -0.07 at the turn was noise). Cued push to 151 ground. After turn at 5000 (north, about 3 min): re-push to about 160-162 ground. Finish cue about 600 m out (on last leg south after turn at 6250).

arguments.message: 650 m to go: cue the final sprint (finish) if reserve allows

text: Cued push to 151 s/500: shaft 182 W vs sustainable 200 W with 56 pct reserve and 2.3 km left; set a watch to call the final sprint at 650 m.

arguments.message: Boat power (from speed) more than 7 pct under sustainable for a minute
Boat power (from speed) more than 15 pct over sustainable for 45 s

arguments.text: Min 25.5 at 4750 m: POD FAILED / DRIFTED LOW. Shaft fell 180 to 143 W in about a minute while speed through water stayed 3.15-3.16 and boat power 124-126; push_local jumped to +0.33 vs push_along +0.08. Ignore all pod numbers (shaft, w_bal_pod_frac, sustainable_shaft, push_local). Use boat-speed numbers: power_w (CP 123), reserve_left_pct (61), sustainable_pace_s500 (156.8 water). Removed pod watches, added boat_too_easy / boat_too_hard. Plan: push to about 160 ground on north leg 5 after turn at 5000, finish cue at about 600 m.

text: No cue: the too-easy alert was false; the paddle pod has drifted low (shaft 143 W while boat speed is unchanged). Switched to boat-speed numbers and will re-target pace after the turn in 250 m.

arguments.text: Last full leg, 1.7 km to go. Push hard to the turn.

Min 27.1 turn at 5000 into leg 5 north, 1689 m left: boat power 118-126 (CP 123), boat reserve 55 pct, sustainable 156.7 water = about 159 ground here. Cued push to 159 ground. Next: after the turn at 6250 (500 m to finish, southbound, current helps), cue FINISH (finish_go watch at 650 m will likely fire just before the turn; finish sprint there is fine).

text: Cued push to 159 s/500 for the last full leg: boat-speed numbers show 55 pct reserve and pace 4.7 s slower than sustainable with 1.7 km left.

arguments.message: Boat power more than 6 pct over sustainable for 36 s before the final sprint: ease slightly (about 161 ground northbound)

arguments.text: Min 27.6, 1596 m left: paddler answered the push hard: boat 141 W, ground 156.4 (target 159), boat reserve 45 pct, runs out in 495 m at this power. Sustainable about 128 W = about 161 ground on this leg (push_along -0.09). Gate closed 35 s; boat_hot watch wakes me if still hot, then cue hold at 161.

text: No cue (gate closed 35 s): paddler overshot the push to 141 W; watch set to ease them to about 161 s/500 if they stay hot.

arguments.text: Too hot. Ease to 160 pace, save it for the turn.

Min 28.3, 1463 m left: paddler overshot (boat 148 W, ground 153, boat reserve 28 pct, empties in 228 m). Cued EASE to 160 ground (sustainable about 127 W = about 161 ground northbound). Reserve is only about 1.7-2.6 kJ now: finish sprint should be SHORT, from about 300-400 m (after the turn at 6250, southbound with help). Change finish_go to about 400 m.

arguments.message: 420 m to go: cue the final sprint (finish)

text: Cued ease to 160 s/500: paddler at 148 W would empty the reserve 1.2 km before the finish; moved the sprint call to 420 m out.

arguments.message: 470 m to go, just after the last turn: cue FINISH sprint now
Gate open: cancel the ease. Cue push about 152 ground on this northbound leg (current now helps)

arguments.text: Min 28.8 KEY: speed jump on leg 5 (boat model 146-151 W, reserve to 19 pct) is NOT the paddler: pod flat 137-140 (same as at 124 W boat on leg 4), feel 7/10 (lowest of race). A current/wind change now HELPS northbound (true push about +0.09, fitted -0.07 lags). Boat-model power/reserve/sustainable now WRONG until refit; pod also broken. Best estimate: true effort about CP+4 pct, true reserve about 45 pct, sustainable about +7 pct over CP. My ease-to-160 cue at 28.4 was a mistake; cancel with push about 152 ground at gate open. Last 500 m after turn at 6250 is INTO this current: sprint from 470 m.

text: No cue (gate closed): the speed jump looks like a current change, not extra effort (pod flat, feel 7/10); removed boat-speed watches and set a wake-up to cancel the ease when the gate opens.

arguments.text: Current is with you now. Push, strong to the last turn.

Min 29.5, 1235 m left: ease cue showed in pod (137 to 131) and boat model (147 to 141) together, so pod still tracks effort with a fixed low gain and the earlier boat jump was the current. True effort now about CP or just under, feel 7/10. Cued push to 150 ground (about +8-10 pct power). Boat reserve 2 pct is FALSE. Turn at 6250 (about 735 m), then FINISH cue at 470 m (watch finish_go3).

text: Cued push to 150 s/500: cancelled my mistaken ease, the paddler is near critical power with reserve left and the current helping on this leg.
No cue: holding about critical power with no fade, 150 m to the last turn; the finish sprint cue is set for 470 m out, just after the turn.

arguments.text: Last 450 metres. Everything now, sprint to the line!

text: Cued the finish sprint at 460 m out, just after the last turn, with reserve left by my estimate.
No cue: the finish sprint is already called and under way, 435 m to go.
No cue: 160 m left and the sprint is on (rate 66); the apparent fade is mostly the head current on this last leg, and a cue would only land in the final 100 m.
